== Summary ==
Origins play hall during the [[2008 US East Nationals]] top 4: [[Justin Desai]] (centre, black cap) played a Hollingworth, while the Reflections III sealed-deck side event ("cody vs klema") ran at the neighbouring tables.

* '''Source:''' [https://www.flickr.com/photos/28182354@N06/2627544899/ "2events"], flickr, posted by brad227lex on 1 July 2008. flickr caption: "desai v hollingworth in the top 4 of nationals, cody vs klema in the ref 3 sealed deck event"
* '''Original image:''' https://live.staticflickr.com/3102/2627544899_8d5784f1ef_o.jpg (3264×2448, Kodak EasyShare M883)
* '''Date:''' 28 June 2008 (camera time 17:56)
* '''Photographer:''' [[Brad Eier]] (flickr user ''brad227lex''), chairperson of the [[2008 US East Nationals]]. The account is his: its bye-card photo is captioned "this is the card i got at yavin" and the card bears the handwritten name Brad Eier (see [[:File:2008 Worlds Day 2 bye card Yavin IV Regional Brad Eier.jpg]]), and the sealed-deck caption says "we ran" the side event.
* '''Licence:''' flickr lists the photo as All Rights Reserved. Uploaded as a record of the tournament with the wiki owner's approval; credit the photographer and link the flickr page when reusing.
* '''Identification:''' flickr caption. Desai wears the same cap and shirt as in the final. The caption gives only the surname "Hollingworth"; [[Tom Hollingworth]] and [[Brian Hollingworth]] were both active in 2008, so the opponent is not named here. "Cody" and "Klema" are not identified.
